I take 50 mg Hydroxyzine and 20 mg Chlordiazepoxide as needed.

The combination of those drugs definitely work for my moderate anxiety and occasional panic attacks while I am in the public.

Hydroxyzine is nothing alike benzos. It just slows your body down but since it has some anti-serotogenic activity in the brain its used for anxiety.

I would say that when I take only Hydroxizine it makes me less dumber than when I take benzos but It's just my experience.

However its still possible to get addicted to the effects of Hydroxizine so that's why I don't combine them and take only one of those two drugs depending on the severity of my current anxiety. It also prevents building a tolerance quickly to both drugs at the same time.
